email.subject: New sign-in to your Microsoft account
email.body_text:
Hi Alex,

We noticed a new sign-in to your Microsoft account from Chrome on Windows in Seattle, WA on 3 September.

If this was you, no action is needed. If you don't recognise this activity, review your recent activity at https://account.microsoft.com/security and change your password.

Thanks,
The Microsoft account team

label: CLEAN
notes: Genuine security notification. Contains sign-in/password language and a security link, which is exactly what a phishing lure imitates.
